Armor[]

Name of armor Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
Raytheon TA-4 2029-2052 United States First armor model to feature an independent power supply while providing full coverage of the wearer.
General Dynamics TA-19 2043-2059 United States Lightweight, long battery life armored exoskeleton.
General Dynamics TA-25 2049-2068 United States General purpose armor
Raytheon-Orbital VA-7 2051-2062 United States Vacuum rated armor
Type 41 Armor 2041-2053 Japan First general purpose armor.
Type 49 Armor 2049-2061 Japan Heavy armored exoskeleton rated for micro-artillery fire.
Type 53 Kozane 2053-2070 Japan Most technologically sophisticated armor of the war.

Small Arms[]

Rifles and LMGs[]

Name of firearm Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
M505 Battlerifle 2021-2052 United States .50 Battle rifle. First rifle to incorporate guided munitions.
Type 41 Rifle 2041 Japan 8mm lightweight guided battlerifle


Shotguns[]

Pistols and SMGs[]

Name of firearm Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
Ruger H13 2039-2071 United States 13mm Semi-automatic pistol. In 2052 the weapon was given a magnetic assistor and a wider range of ammunition varieties.

Heavy Arms[]

Railguns[]

Name of firearm Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
BAE Model 14 2042-2059 United States First light weight mobile railgun. Required a two person crew to operate with a rate of fire of 4 rounds per minute. Original power source only allowed for 13 shots.
M3 Magnetic Rifle 2053-2072 United States 30mm armor mounted railgun. 50 round shot count.
Type 50 Railgun 2050-2066 Japan 30mm armor mounted railgun. 29 shot limit.

Tanks and Artillery[]

Name of vehicle Type Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
M5-A2 Schwarzkopf Armored Fighting Vehicle 2030-2052 United States High speed UAGV. Modular armament platform.
PD-9 Pitbull Armored Fighting Vehicle 2041 United States Fire support vehicle.

Aircraft[]

Name of aircraft Type Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
Northrop Grumman AQ-47 Pegasus Subsonic Attack Aircraft 2027-2055 United States First carrier based UCAV.
Lockheed SR-72 Wraith Hypersonic Recon/Attack Aircraft 2027-2055 United States First hypersonic attack aircraft.
Boeing AQ-51 Kestrel Hypersonic Attack Aircraft 2045-2055 United States Near-space operation.
Boeing FQ-47 Ghostfighter Unmanned Tactical Fighter 2034-2055 United States First dedicated unmanned fighter.
Northrop Grumman B-21 Raider Subsonic Bomber Aircraft 2037-2055 United States Medium flying-wing bomber.
Northrop Grumman AQ-63 Serval Hypersonic Attack Aircraft 2053-2061 United States Near-space operation.
Mitsubishi FQ-5 Unmanned Tactical Fighter 2041 Japan Based on FQ-9 Sparrowhawk

Spacecraft[]

Name of spacecraft Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
Mk.1 OCS 2037-2051 United States First generation military space platforms.
Mk.2 OCS 2052-2069 United States Second generation military space platform
C-8 Super Shuttle 2051-2053 United States First generation American space to surface troop carrier.
A-5 Guardian 2051-2059 United States First generation American assault carrier. Crew of 28 armored space operators or drones.
Type 48 Assault Carrier 2048 - 2055 Japan First Assault Carrier. Crew of 20 armored space operators.
Type 54 Gunship 2054- 2055 Japan Single cannon gunship deployed for close orbit defense.
Type 53 Drop Carrier 2053 - 2055 Japan Earth to Space launched orbital drop troop carrier.


Ships[]

Lead ship in class Type Years
in service 		Country of origin Description
USS Gerald R. Ford Aircraft Carrier 2017-2051 United States Last crewed aircraft carrier in the US Navy
USS Michael Mullen Aircraft Carrier 2043-2055 United States Large unmanned aircraft carrier.
USS Columbia Ballistic missile submarine 2031-2085 United States Converted for hypersonic missiles and submarine launched aircraft.
USS Devil Ray Submersible anti-ship drone 2029-2055 United States Autonomous anti-submarine platform carrying Mark 53 "Remora" torpedoes
USS Whale shark Drone arsenal sub 2039-2062 United States Autonomous submarine carrying 80 short range, and later long range hypersonic loitering munitions.
Hiryu Aircraft carrier submarine 2041 Japan Carries 12 FQ-5s
